_readme: Checkout links (Lemon Squeezy product > Share), store ID and customer billing page; supabaseUrl and supabaseAnonKey from Supabase > Project Settings > API (the anon/public key is meant to be public). Set "live" to true once the links are LIVE-mode links and accounts are set up; until then everyone stays in launch mode and nothing is locked. Add ?paywall=1 to the site address to test. ownerHash is the fingerprint of the creator's key (the key itself is never stored here).
